reservation_policy: Eight spatially distributed intersections were reserved before candidate model fitting/selection. Only the other28 influence the shipped transform. The eight are never used as geometry anchors.

rejected_candidates.reason: Ornamental corner frame obscures the historical street opening; modern target exists but no defensible map pixel was selected.

historical_continuity_limit: Modern road centreline intersections are not a cadastral survey of1870. Later widening, realignment, divided carriageways, OSM averaging and map engraving remain independent errors. Cermak originaltarget averaging spread6m is unresolved.
